notes: The footstep on the tiled floor is back to the old one. The new sound that came in the last version was too muffled, and no amount of volume adjustment fixed it.

notes_by_language.pt_BR: O passo no piso de azulejo voltou a ser o de sempre. O som novo que entrou na versão passada era abafado demais, e nenhum ajuste de volume resolvia.
notes_by_language.en_US: The footstep on the tiled floor is back to the old one. The new sound that came in the last version was too muffled, and no amount of volume adjustment fixed it.
